title: China eyes curbs on AI, biotech, solar exports
description: China has unveiled a draft for export controls targeting artificial intelligence and biotechnology technologies, aiming to impose a total ban on 14 specific technologies, notably harmful AI-driven code generation. Additionally, it seeks to limit exports of 26 other techs with potential hacking capabilities, addressing widespread concerns over technological misuse. This proposal is currently available for public feedback for one month.

title: AI and jobs: The technology issue entering America's midterm debate
description: US President Donald Trump has dismissed concerns about artificial intelligence as a “Hoax”, arguing that tighter controls could undermine America's lead over China. title: Global Market: European shares set for biggest weekly gain since August on earnings optimism
description: European shares climbed on Friday, with the STOXX 600 heading for its strongest weekly gain since August, supported by robust corporate earnings and stabilising technology stocks. Industrial stocks led advances, while investors monitored eurozone inflation data, elevated oil prices and artificial intelligence spending concerns for clues on monetary policy and growth.
